requirements.text: 10+ years full stack software development experience building enterprise APIs and core Java with Spring/Spring boot.
Experience with web services - JSON, XML, REST, SOAP, etc.
Experience designing event driven micro services architect and real-time streaming ingestion pipelines using technologies such as Kafka
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and AWS cloud deployment/application management.

Experience building complex PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions for sub-second query response times and high-throughput data access for critical business applications using database like oracle, cockroachDB etc
Experience with unit testing and test automation libraries/strategies.
Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to improve engineering productivity and code quality
Experience building and deploying applications using continuous integration pipelines and automated deployment tools such as Jenkins.
Experience using source control and pull requests for collaborative development in code repository tools such as GitHub.
